description: This file defines the React context and hooks for managing the state of a Kanban board application. It manages columns and cards, handles data fetching from a Supabase backend, provides CRUD operations, real-time updates, and CSV-based synchronization with undo functionality.

methods.name: useKanban()
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the Kanban context.

methods.name: KanbanProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides the Kanban context, managing columns, cards, and related actions.

methods.name: safeLoadArchivedColumnIds()
methods.description: Parses archived column IDs from localStorage, returning a Set of IDs.

methods.name: safeSaveArchivedColumnIds(idSet)
methods.description: Saves the current set of archived column IDs to localStorage.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all columns and cards data from Supabase and updates local state.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to the board.

methods.name: archiveColumn
methods.description: Marks a column as archived in the UI-only state.

methods.name: unarchiveColumn
methods.description: Removes a column from the archived set, restoring its visibility.

methods.name: deleteColumn
methods.description: Deletes a column from the backend and updates UI state.

methods.name: reorderColumns
methods.description: Reorders columns based on a specified list.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to a specific column.

methods.name: deleteCard
methods.description: Deletes a card from the backend and UI state.

methods.name: reorderCardsInColumn
methods.description: Reorders cards within a specific column.

methods.name: bulkInsertCards
methods.description: Inserts multiple cards at once into a column, handling position assignment.

methods.name: syncCardsFromCsv
methods.description: Synchronizes cards from CSV text, updating the backend and state.

methods.name: syncCardsFromCsvWithUndo
methods.description: Performs CSV sync with undo capabilities, including snapshot creation.

methods.name: undoLastCsvSyncRestore
methods.description: Undoes the last CSV synchronization using stored snapshots.
